diviner_prp_south.measures: annual mean / max temperature, depth to stable ice
diviner_prp_south.verified: handled by job J13 (writes diviner_regions.json); listed here so the catalogue is complete
caveats: Model product: thermal model fits to the first year of Diviner mapping (prpds.cat), not raw measurements; temp_avg is at 2 cm depth, temp_max at the surface.
The mesh comes from a Kaguya laser-altimeter DEM (Araki et al. 2009, prpds.cat), about 0.5 km triangles, so features below ~1 km (small craters, ridge crests) are smoothed.
Ice-stability depths are capped: anything deeper than 2.8738 m is coded -999.

ice_depth also holds the value -1, which neither the label (dlre_prp.fmt) nor the SIS (document/Diviner_RDR_SIS.pdf, section 7.1) describes. In the loaded records -1 occurs only where the annual maximum surface temperature is <= 101.3 K, colder than every depth-0 triangle (101.3-129.9 K), so it plausibly marks surface cold traps too; meaning UNVERIFIED. Shares are given both without and with code -1; 'defined' depths exclude it.
The SIS (section 7.1) names the missing constant -32768 while the label and the file use -999.

diviner_info.product: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product, south (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, DLRE_PRP_SOUTH.TAB, product version 2, created 2018-02-21)
diviner_info.citation: Paige et al., LRO DLRE LEVEL 5 PRP V2.0, NASA Planetary Data System, LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, 2018 (citation requested in catalog/prpds.cat). Method: Paige, D. A. et al. (2010) Diviner Lunar Radiometer observations of cold traps in the Moon's south polar region, Science 330, 479-482, doi:10.1126/science.1187726.

units.temp_avg_K: K, annual average temperature at 2 cm below the surface (label)
units.ice_depth: m, depth at which water ice sublimates at 1 kg m-2 per billion years; 0 = stable at the surface; -999 = deeper than 2.8738 m (label)

diviner_info.shares: area-weighted by triangle area computed from the vertex coordinates
diviner_info.coverage: Mesh covers a square centred on the pole reaching 80 deg S at the edge midpoints (prpds.cat: 'covers a square region centred on the pole to 80 degrees latitude'); the corners reach about 75.9 deg S (first record, tri_clat -75.905). Every region window here lies inside it (largest |x|,|y| about 168 km vs about 300 km half-width).
diviner_info.region_selection: triangle centre (tri_clon, tri_clat) projected with pipeline.io_moon.moon_xy and tested against window_m of data/moon/reference.json

registry_note: LRO south-polar map products checked in job J15 (2026-11-14); sizes from HTTP HEAD
coordinates_note: Coordinates are LUNAR (latitude, east longitude 0-360); window_m is south polar stereographic metres on a 1,737,400 m sphere (IAU 30135), as in pipeline.io_moon.moon_xy.
pooled_note: pooled_regions: reference populations made of the cells of several named regions together (no single window); pipeline.score reads them like regions.

footprints.note: Coordinates are LUNAR latitude / east longitude (degrees), not Earth. Longitudes are unwrapped around each region (may fall slightly outside 0-360); polar_160km encloses the pole.
